deal_events_chain_fields.name: deal_events_chain_fields
deal_events_chain_fields.value: "deal_events"."source" <> 'chain' OR ("deal_events"."tx_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "deal_events"."log_index" IS NOT NULL AND "deal_events"."block_number" IS NOT NULL)

deals_status_consistency.name: deals_status_consistency
deals_status_consistency.value:
("deals"."status" <> 'settled' OR ("deals"."settle_tx" IS NOT NULL AND "deals"."settled_at" IS NOT NULL))
      AND ("deals"."status" <> 'refunded' OR ("deals"."refund_tx" IS NOT NULL AND "deals"."refunded_at" IS NOT NULL))
